title: How Use Case Tables Enable the Elicitation of Explanation Needs
abstract: arXiv:2611.32809v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: [Context and motivation] While software systems get more integrated into people's daily lives - like driver-assistance systems or smart-home applications - they are also becoming increasingly complex. When complex software is used, needs for explanations may arise. At present, explanation needs are usually elicited through the testing of prototypes or existing software. However, detailed documentation of software interactions, such as use case tables, might be a suitable alternative. Since use cases provide early insights into the key interactions within the system, they are appealing to employ as resources for explanation needs. [Question/problem] As of now, it remains unclear whether use cases allow the elicitation of explanation needs. Or, from a different perspective, whether their utilization for this purpose is desirable. translated_title: 用例表如何支持解释需求的获取
translated_abstract: [背景与动机] 随着软件系统日益融入人们的日常生活——例如驾驶辅助系统或智能家居应用——它们也变得越来越复杂。在使用复杂软件时，可能会产生对解释的需求。目前，解释需求通常通过测试原型或现有软件来获取。然而，软件交互的详细文档（如用例表）可能是一种合适的替代方案。由于用例能够早期揭示系统内的关键交互，因此将其作为解释需求的来源颇具吸引力。[问题] 目前尚不清楚用例是否能够支持解释需求的获取，或者换个角度看，将其用于此目的是否可取。[主要思路/结果] 我们开展了一项研究，让用户仔细阅读现有用例的描述部分……
tldr: 本研究探讨了用例表能否作为原型测试的替代方案，在软件开发早期获取用户的解释需求，并通过让用户阅读用例描述的实证研究加以验证。
en_tdlr: This study investigates whether use case tables can serve as an alternative to prototype testing for eliciting explanation needs early in software development, validated through a study in which users read use case descriptions.
